method: manual source-contract review of preserved effective answers; no new model trials
scope: 88 frozen forward prompts and criteria; 86 preserved effective observedResponse texts plus 2 historical cases with missing observedResponse; PR #9 diff reviewed against the named baseline.
evidenceLimits: 书面源合同复核，不是 88 次新模型试跑。
原有 pass 和旧评语不作为本次通过依据；responseSha256 绑定完整有效 observedResponse 的 UTF-8 文本。
两条历史答复缺失以 null 哈希保留，不以旧审查结论冒充原答复。
本报告不证明 Antigravity 新宿主发现、完整 Soul 激活、偏好跨会话生效、实际 SillyTavern 或驾驶员验收。
